description: This Java class 'GroupImportHandler' handles the import of group data from an Excel workbook into the system. It processes group details, meetings, and associated entities, creates commands for the Fineract platform, and manages import status reporting.

classes.name: GroupImportHandler
classes.description: Handles the import process for groups from Excel files, including reading data, creating commands, error handling, and reporting.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point to process a workbook: reads the data and initiates import.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads the group and meeting data from the Excel sheet.

methods.name: readMeeting
methods.description: Extracts meeting schedule data from a row.

methods.name: readGroup
methods.description: Extracts group details from a row and related sheets.

methods.name: containsClientId
methods.description: Checks whether a client ID is already present in the list.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Imports the list of groups and meetings into the system, updating statuses and handling errors.

methods.name: writeGroupErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error messages into the Excel sheet when import fails at various points.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Adds headers to the import report sheet.

methods.name: importGroupMeeting
methods.description: Creates and logs commands to import calendar data for group meetings.

methods.name: importGroup
methods.description: Creates and logs commands to import group data.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the import progress status based on the current row's status.
